newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up on percieved firm cargo level.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up on percieved firm cargo level.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices nudged higher on Wednesday on expectations of higher cargo prices.

Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at $96-97 per tonne, higher than Tuesday's $94-96. Most sellers said they would not move prices below $97. Traders said some independents were offering lower than cargo quotes. Cargo prices for 380 cst were at $91-93 on Tuesday.

Traders said most majors preferred to sell their fuel oil supplies in the cargo market, citing falling margins due to a narrowing spread between cargo and bunker quotes and falling barge sales. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3082)
